ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Weë needs access to your camera so you can take photos and videos to share in your posts.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Weë needs access to your microphone to record audio in your videos.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Weë needs access to your photo library so you can choose photos and videos to share.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Weë needs permission to save videos to your photo library.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Weë uses your approximate location only while the app is open, to help you discover nearby content and communities. Your exact location is never shown publicly.
